description:
The Moon is rusting — and on an airless world with no water, that should be impossible. In 2020, scientists found hematite (iron oxide) at the Moon's poles, mostly on the side facing Earth. So where is the oxygen coming from? The answer: Earth itself.

In this video we trace the full detective chain: Earth's magnetic tail, six days of oxygen-rich 'Earth wind' every month, the solar wind getting blocked, polar ice, and dust impacts — all conspiring to rust a world that was never supposed to rust. We also cover why it matters for the Artemis program and future lunar bases.

Chapters:
0:00 The Moon Is Rusting
0:23 What Rust Really Needs
1:08 The Solar Wind Problem
1:21 The 2020 Discovery
1:59 Earth's Invisible Tail
2:42 The Hydrogen Problem Solved
3:26 Tested in the Lab
4:01 Why Artemis Cares
4:52 The Mystery Is Not Closed
5:13 The Full Chain
5:47 Earth Is the Reason

Sources: Li et al., Science Advances (2020), DOI 10.1126/sciadv.aba1940; lunar hematite lab experiments, Geophysical Research Letters (2025).

This video uses AI-generated imagery and voiceover (disclosed per YouTube policy). The science is based on published, peer-reviewed research.

hook_chosen: A (Curiosity Gap): 'The Moon is rusting. And on an airless world with no water — that should be completely impossible.' On-screen: 'THE MOON IS RUSTING'. First frame: extreme macro of rust-red oxide streaks across grey cratered lunar soil.
hook_why: Names the contradiction in one breath; spoken line, on-screen text, and first frame fire the SAME claim simultaneously; opens a loop ('how?') it never answers. Chosen over B (contrarian, vaguer) and C (question/open-loop, split-frame visual divides attention).

production.assembly: rakit_light.py (kenburns, 1280x720, veryfast, noise grain, vignette), all ffmpeg via ffmpeg-queue.sh
production.image_style: photorealistic, literal to narration, one image per beat (~15s)
production.sfx: subtle low brown-noise ambient rumble bed (lowpass 100Hz, -~24dB under VO) mixed across full duration; film grain + vignette baked in via rakit_light.py
production.voice: avocado_v2:MAI_03 (Smooth, EN), consistent narrator, slowed 0.92x for documentary pacing

topic_justification: Uncommon idea (rust on an airless, waterless world), broad TAM (space-curious audience), fresh lens (detective story: Earth is the culprit via 'Earth wind' oxygen through the magnetotail). Real, validated science: 2020 Science Advances study (Shuai Li et al.) on hematite at lunar high latitudes via Chandrayaan-1/M3; 2025 lab confirmation of Earth-wind oxidation.
